en: A vintage postcard designed to look like the front page of the Portuguese newspaper "O Seculo". In the middle, a torn-paper effect reveals a black‑and‑white photograph of a large Gothic‑Manueline monastery with towers and an ornate façade. Below the image, another torn opening contains the printed caption "Lisboa. Mosteiro dos Jeronymos." The rest of the visible page is dense Portuguese newspaper text with the masthead "O SECULO" at the top.
